test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains grammatical error.**

I can clearly / recollect the day / as I first / met you.
solution:
The erroneous partof the sentence is: **as I first**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace '**as**' with '**when**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• We can use '**as**&
